skills.name: Basic
skills.desc: Deals 120% ATK DMG to a single target, with a 100% chance to inflict [Collapse] for 2 rounds. [Collapse]: Decreases DMG Free%.

skills.name: Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 350% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 2 rounds. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Rate by 10% and deals 200% ATK [Collapse DMG] when attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse].

skills.name: Ultra-Ultimate
skills.desc: Attacks all enemies with 5 consecutive strikes, dealing 450% ATK DMG. The last strike has a 100% chance to inflict [Specialized Collapse] on the main target for 2 rounds. [Specialized Collapse]: Decreases DMG Rate by 15% and deals 250% ATK [Collapse DMG] when attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse].

skills.name: Passive
skills.desc: Grants self 50% [Non-Crit DMG Free] for 4 rounds. After receiving fatal DMG, revives with 50% Max HP. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: Extreme Passive
skills.desc: Grants self 60% [Non-Crit DMG Free] for 5 rounds. After receiving fatal DMG, revives with 100% Max HP. Can revive up to 2 times. [Non-Crit DMG Free]: Effective against all types of DMG and cannot coexist with [Agility].

skills.name: 5★ Passive
skills.desc: Non-Crit DMG Free duration 4 rounds → 5 roundsRevive HP 50% → 100%

skills.name: Awaken 1 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, decreases all enemies’ ATK by 30% and gains 20% Drain Rate for 2 rounds. Before any character acts, launches an [Ultimate Follow-up], once per round. [Ultimate Follow-up]: Deals 60% DMG with 100% effect.

skills.name: Awaken 2 Passive
skills.desc: When battle begins, decreases all enemies’ ATK by 40% and gains 30% Drain Rate for 2 rounds. Before any character acts, launches an [Ultimate Follow-up], once per round. Gains 20% [Collapse Rate]. [Ultimate Follow-up]: Deals 100% DMG with 100% effect.

effects.desc: Decreases DMG Rate and deals [Collapse DMG] whenever the affected unit is attacked. Stacks up to 3 times and does not stack with [Collapse].
Additional ATK-based damage triggered when a unit affected by [Specialized Collapse] is attacked.
